correctness.rationale: Finite-state first-event recursion follows exact exponential clock competition and terminates. All 9 connected graph isomorphism types of order 2–4, represented by 43 labeled graphs, have 82 exact pairwise winner comparisons checked by positive polynomial coefficients. The paw comparison has numerator β²(2β⁴−32β³−58β²−33β−6), a positive denominator, and the quartic has exactly one positive root by Descartes plus sign at 0 and infinity. Explicit rational differences at β=18 were independently verified by event-path enumeration for all 12 seed/threshold probabilities. Bounds and tie cases are stated.

value.rationale: The sharp minimal network order and unique four-site topology where the worst initial seed changes across clinical peak-capacity thresholds are natural epidemiological network invariants. Three distinct peak thresholds yield a re-entrant winner sequence, not a routine restatement or arbitrary fixed-parameter evaluation. The exact transition is a reusable test for source-risk and capacity models, with clear nonempirical limitations.
